items.title: 54271_Charlie Holmes oral history interview
items.q: But Jimmy Dorsey, Tommy Dorsey, Dick McDonough, you name 'em, they were all up there.

ctx.x: also; he used to come in there. Of course, he wasn't Benny Goodman then. He was just another clarinetist. But Jimmy Dorsey, Tommy Dorsey, Dick McDonough, you name 'em, they were all up there. And they were diggin' that beat; you know, that New Orleans beat that they were puttin' down. Because nobody else was playing it. And they were diggin' it.
Of course, to Russell it didn't mean a thing. Well, that sounded good to me. That's all I wanted to do, was listen at it. I'd get off the stand. That's my paranoia(?). But they would be wailin'.
